diagnosticCorrection.disposition: Discarded 19 numerical samples as invalid diagnostic output, not an artifact failure or acceptance result.
diagnosticCorrection.symptom: Non-finite ratios serialized as null; the control correctly stopped before any mock edit.

method.fixture: file:///Users/eg/work/dude/.dude/specs/062-dude-canvas-workspace-integration/design/workspace-integration.html?theme=light|dark&data=progress&view=now&select=062; the existing visibly labeled frozen progress example is rendered, never changed. All/Pending/Done are selected with native pointer input; a separate identical before/after native Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter flow checks inspection retention and dismissal.
method.captureFraming: Viewport screenshots are scrolled to center the affected task-filter count, not initial-entry or full-page captures. The light before/after pair uses identical scroll position and geometry.
method.rendering: Repository launchBrowser, fresh isolated headless browser, file URL only; native CDP pointer and keyboard input.
method.contrast: Computed RGBA foreground, count opacity, transparent count background and opaque parent background are read from the renderer. Ancestor opacity 1 and no image/filter/blend are verified. unroundedBlendRatio is the WCAG acceptance ratio, retaining fractional sRGB compositing before luminance (reproduces 4.354); ratio separately discloses the rounded-display-RGB calculation (4.355). Display RGB is descriptive, not the acceptance arithmetic.
method.comparison: Before and after use the same file URL, query, dimensions, input sequence, scroll positioning and computed-style/geometry/markup digests. Controlled in-memory stylesheet insertion changes opacity alone, then is removed.
method.zoomEquivalent: 720x500 CSS px at DPR 2 renders 1440x1000 pixels: 200% width/reflow/raster equivalence for 1440x1000. visualViewport.scale remains 1; this is NOT native browser UI zoom or text-only zoom.
method.boundary: Only selected count contrast, adjacent unselected counts, layout and one task-filter/inspection flow; no broad suite or hidden/request/review/host/product coverage.
